info.name: Resume RAG - Phase 14
info.description: Verification requests for stable ingestion error handling.

exec: pm.test('Missing file returns FILE_REQUIRED', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('FILE_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Resume PDF is required'); });

item.name: POST Resume Ingest - Invalid File Type

exec: pm.test('Invalid file type returns 415', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(415); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('INVALID_FILE_TYPE'); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Only PDF files are allowed'); });

pm.test('Request ID is included in the error', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.requestId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('x-request-id')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: POST Resume Ingest - File Too Large

exec: pm.test('Oversized file returns 413', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(413); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('FILE_TOO_LARGE'); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Resume exceeds maximum upload size'); });

pm.test('Request ID is included in the error', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.requestId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('x-request-id')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Empty resume returns extraction failure', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('RESUME_EXTRACTION_FAILED'); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Resume extraction failed'); });

pm.test('Request ID is included in the error', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.requestId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('x-request-id')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: POST Resume Embed - Provider Failure Contract

exec: pm.test('Embedding configuration failure is stable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.be.oneOf(['EMBEDDING_NOT_CONFIGURED', 'EMBEDDING_FAILED']); pm.expect(body.message).to.be.a('string'); });
